Embedded source matcher runtime

Nodejs-Mobile 18.20.4: licenses/Nodejs-Mobile-LICENSE.txt
JNA 5.17.0: licenses/JNA-LICENSE.txt and JNA-APACHE-2.0.txt (Apache-2.0 option)
Android NDK r24 libc++: licenses/NDK-r24-NOTICE.txt, NDK-r24-NOTICE.toolchain.txt and libc++abi-*
@unblockneteasemusic/server 0.28.0: LGPL-3.0-only; node_modules/@unblockneteasemusic/server/COPYING and COPYING.LESSER

The Node package main matcher is used directly; Windows service helpers and CLI/proxy servers are not shipped. yt-dlp/youtube-dl sources require subprocess executables and are omitted from the active source list. No account Cookie is embedded or used by this matcher.
